---
name: css-advanced-layout
description: Implement robust responsive layouts, modern CSS architecture, grid, flexbox, container queries, and maintainable styling.
---
# Advanced CSS and layout
- Prefer mobile-first responsive design with Grid, Flexbox, and container queries where appropriate.
- Use design tokens and logical properties; avoid brittle absolute positioning for core layouts.
- Define breakpoints based on content needs rather than device names alone.
- Prevent overflow, layout shifts, and unreadable dense tables; test long strings and zoom.
- Use CSS layers or scoped conventions consistent with the existing project.
- Keep selectors maintainable and avoid unnecessary !important.
